description: Before the death of Herod (4 BC)

description: From his baptism by John to the crucifixion

description: On the road to Damascus

description: Described in a letter preserved by Eusebius

description: Debated: some date it to the 4th century

description: Cyprian of Carthage is executed

description: Constantine and Licinius grant toleration to Christians

description: Condemns Arius; the Nicene Creed

description: Mary is Theotokos; Nestorius condemned

description: Christ in two natures, one person

description: Romulus Augustulus deposed

description: Condemns the Three Chapters

description: Christ has two wills

title: Second Council of Nicaea
description: Restores the veneration of icons

description: The Masoretes' model codex of the Hebrew Bible
